document.about: Kohler K-R33912 spec sheet. Its Recommended Products/Accessories section lists one item beside a drawn bullet, the same size and as far from its text as the page's other lists' bullets.

notes: #275: a drawn dot marked a line only where another dot at the same place marked another, so a list of one item read as a paragraph.

checks.issue: #275: `K-23723 Faucet cleaner`, one item beside its drawn bullet, was a paragraph.
